tests_may_change_note: The two existing 'self' cases a careful fix may fold into a table (audit A). Skip-list edits in runTest() calls are outside named cases and never trip the trap, so no file-wide entry is needed; a run that silences a broken shared case through a skip list fails the hidden guard t1-routers.test.ts instead.

naive_patches.naive.patch: Keeps the first value only on the plain-segment path of TrieRouter's search, not on the path for a parameter with a pattern: `/:id/:id{[0-9]+}` still returns the second value.

hidden_tests_note: The upstream fix's own tests that fail on the base (TrieRouter node and router cases, the app-level SmartRouter fallback), plus 'self after another parameter' (audit A: /:a/:id/:id), in t1.test.ts. t1-routers.test.ts is a guard that passes on the base: every router runs a frozen copy of the starting shared cases (t1-common-cases.ts) with the starting skip lists, so silencing a broken case through a skip list fails it.
